posts.raw_content:
...No Jesus, No peace...Know Jesus, Know Peace...


One generation shall praise Your works to another, and shall declare Your mighty acts. —Psalm 145:4

...Thru the Bible - Sunday Sermon   Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

The Name of the Lord

God’s name is holy—and the third commandment reminds us not to treat it lightly. In Exodus 20:7, Dr. J. Vernon McGee shows us that taking God’s name in vain is about far more than profanity. This challenging look at God’s holy name invites us to examine our hearts and discover mercy in His presence.

References: Exodus 20:7

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-sunday-sermon/?ref=sc

https://ttb.org/

...Thru the Bible - Minute with McGee - Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

Open my eyes

“Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures.” There are things that are above human comprehension, and only the Spirit of God can make these things real to us. And our prayer ought to be, “Open Thou mine eyes that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy Word.” We need to bring a humble mind to the study of the Word of God. Just because you read it in the Bible, does not mean you know it. The Spirit of God will have to make it real to you. If you bring to the Bible an honest heart and you sincerely want to know God’s truth, if you have doubts, then bring them to Him.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-minute-with-mcgee/listen/open-my-eyes-1293563.html

https://ttb.org/

...Daily Promises...

For all the promises of God in him [are] yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us. (2 Corinthians 1:20)

God keeps His promises. No matter what His promise may be, He will keep it-and it will be a "Yes" in Christ. Because of His faithfulness through Christ, our proper response should be "Amen," in order that we give Him glory. This should be the goal of all who believe-the further glory of God.

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/promises/view.cfm

...Living a confessed life...

If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. -- 1 John 1:9

You don't have to live defeated by your past if you are living forgiven by the grace of God!

https://digginganotherwell.substack.com/p/living-a-confessed-life

C. H. Spurgeon's Evening Reading (September 13th)

"This man receiveth sinners." — Luke 15:2

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?Time=pm

C. H. Spurgeon's Morning Reading (September 14th)

"There were also with Him other little ships." — Mark 4:36

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?doy=258



...Faith Plus Nothing Equals Salvation...

https://youtu.be/fDR0mu18x80?si=aG5gQZZ3noLTFzQk

https://blueletterbible.org/Comm/mcgee_j_vernon/eBooks/faith-plus-zero-equals-salvation.cfm

“The sin underneath all our sins is to trust the lie of the serpent that we cannot trust the love and grace of Christ and must take matters into our own hands”

Martin Luther



Head Up

Eyes Forward

Hold The Line Patriots

Keep Calm

And

Howl On
